instruction: Open or import the initial file(s) from the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\part_with_vise.step. Set the two vise jaws in C:\Users\User\Desktop\part_with_vise.step as fixture or avoidance geometry. Machine the two top pockets using iMachining or Pocket toolpaths while maintaining at least 3 mm clearance from the fixtures on all low-level toolpath points. Tool definition: T1 is an 8 mm end mill for the two top pockets. Use the SolidCAM CAM-Part, Coordinate System, Stock, Tool Table, operation, simulation/verify, and post-processing dialogs as needed, then save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-11.nc.
